source: Seeded 2026-11-18 from week 11 by auto_overrides.py (out/lead_back/qb_start/ol_out carried; chances dropped). Re-verify against week 12 reports.

team_notes.BAL: Jacoby Brissett starts while Lamar (thumb, IR) and Huntley (toe) are out (Hensley via RotoBaller Nov 8; WagerTalk Nov 16). Feed still lists Huntley until Brissett's first game is played.
team_notes.MIN: Jordan Addison (thumb) out 'for the next few weeks' (Forbes Nov 16). Hockenson expected to progress for Sunday.
team_notes.KC: Kenneth Walker III (groin) OUT at BUF (NFL.com/AtoZ Nov 25); Emmett Johnson lead back. RT Jaylon Moore OUT. Noah Gray questionable (full practice).
team_notes.DEN: Jonah Coleman the lead back (24 of 34 RB carries Wk11); Harvey IR; J.K. Dobbins out (suspended; CBS/Footballguys Nov 24); Badie (thumb) questionable.
team_notes.CHI: RB Roschon Johnson (ankle) OUT for Thanksgiving at DET (NFL.com Wk12 report).
team_notes.ARI: Carson Beck (back spasms) DNP Wed, day-to-day; Josh Johnson in line for a second straight start (azcardinals.com Nov 25). Minshew IR.
team_notes.NYJ: Geno Smith (left ankle) avoided major injury in tests; Glenn: 'Geno's our starter', starts vs LAC if healthy (ESPN Nov 16; Yardbarker Nov 17). Klubnik if not. Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) tests.
team_notes.NYG: Skattebo had all 18 RB carries in the Wk10 TNF game (box score, Nov 12).
team_notes.HOU: Woody Marks (concussion) full practice Wed, trending toward playing (RotoWire Nov 25); NBC Nov 25: No. 2 behind David Montgomery (26 carries Wk11). Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) resumed practice (NBC Nov 25).
team_notes.LV: Brock Bowers (ankle) not believed major, day-to-day; more tests (Rapoport via Forbes Nov 16; Big Lead Nov 17). Mendoza starts.
team_notes.PIT: Mason Rudolph starts vs DEN today (Rodgers released; NFL.com Nov 25). G Gennings Dunker OUT (Steelers final report). Pittman activated, no designation.
team_notes.IND: Daniel Jones released; Anthony Richardson named starter (Colts.com).
team_notes.DET: Aidan Hutchinson torn ACL, out for the season (Big Lead Nov 17).
team_notes.SEA: Darnold full practice Wed-Thu, expected to start vs SF (NFL.com roundup Nov 26). OT Abraham Lucas and G Quenton Nelson ruled out. Charbonnet lead back.
team_notes.NE: Drake Maye fractured fibula, out at least six weeks (Yahoo Nov 23); did not participate Thu (NFL.com roundup Nov 26). Tommy DeVito starts (SI Nov 20). A.J. Brown (hamstring) DNP.
team_notes.LAC: Justin Herbert (concussion protocol) DNP Wed and Thu (NFL.com roundup Nov 26); no starter named. Harbaugh: DJ Uiagalelei next man up, then Jake Browning (signed to active roster Nov 26; chargers.com Nov 24). Still modeled as the starter; recheck Friday report/Saturday.
team_notes.WAS: Croskey-Merritt had 13 of 20 RB carries in Wk11 (box score); lead_back 0.50 kept (committee with Ekeler; no game since). Rachaad White (heel) full; Diggs off the injury report (RotoWire Nov 26).
team_notes.LA: Puka Nacua and Davante Adams out (IR); TE Terrance Ferguson out. Kyren Williams (toe) no designation on the final report (SI Nov 24). LG Avila and C Shelton out.
team_notes.GB: Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable but LaFleur said 'I would say so' when asked if he was unlikely to play (SI/ClutchPoints Nov 24); Kaleb Johnson the lead back. Jayden Reed and Luke Musgrave (neck) out.
team_notes.DAL: TE Jake Ferguson, WR Jonathan Mingo, G Tyler Booker OUT vs PHI (NFL.com Wk12 report; CBS Nov 25). Prescott full all week.
team_notes.BUF: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), G O'Cyrus Torrence questionable, limited all week (CBS Nov 25).
team_notes.SF: Brock Purdy (low ankle sprain) DNP Wed and Thu (NFL.com roundup Nov 26); Mac Jones starts if he can't (Gridiron Heroics/Yahoo Nov 27). McCaffrey DNP Thu. Still modeled with Purdy; recheck Friday report/Saturday. LT Trent Williams DNP.
